abstract: The dexamethasone binding capacity of embryonal carcinoma cells and their differentiated derivatives was investigated. Manipulation of the embryonal carcinoma cell-culture conditions resulted in an unstable reversible expression of the glucocorticoid receptors. Stable expression of the receptors is observed when these cells are induced to differentiate. Cells grown under identical conditions were assayed for their ability to bind epidermal growth factor.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌細胞および分化誘導細胞のデキサメタゾン結合能を検討した。胎児性癌細胞の培養条件を操作すると、グルココルチコイド受容体の発現は不安定で可逆的に変化した。細胞を分化誘導すると受容体発現は安定して認められた。同一条件下で培養した細胞について、上皮成長因子(EGF)結合能も測定した。
